preconditions.description: The number of cities in Ancient Berland is between 3 and 500, inclusive.
The number of roads in Ancient Berland is between 3 and 10,000, inclusive.
The value of importance for each road is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
The cities are indexed from 1 to N.
The start and end city for each road are not the same.

postconditions.description: The output is the product of all separation values over all unordered pairs of cities, modulo 10^9 + 7.
